headline.results_interpretation: The pooled analysis of 3 studies yielded an effect size of 0.94 (95% CI: 0.74–1.2), indicating no statistically significant association between docosahexaenoic acid and prostate cancer\aggressive. Although the point estimate suggests a potential inverse relationship, the confidence interval includes the null. These findings were accompanied by substantial heterogeneity (I² = 55.41%), reflecting considerable variability across studies.
